metadata.host_selection_rule: storage-only: direct child contract with most references; lexical canonical-id tie-break

semantics.source_rule: Replay source references exact historical execution/event/request evidence.
semantics.target_rule: Replay target is explicit test/sandbox environment by default.
semantics.context_rule: Required execution context snapshot inputs are explicit.
semantics.effect_rule: Production effect replay is prohibited unless separately explicitly authorized and intended.
semantics.comparison_rule: Replay observations compare against declared expected/equivalence profile.
semantics.time_rule: Recorded timestamps are inputs/evidence only as declared.
semantics.authority_rule: Historical authorization decision is not automatically reusable for replay.

invariants.rule: Test definitions, fixtures, results, coverage, simulations and release evidence never become production semantic authority or grant production execution rights merely by existing or passing.
Verification evidence binds exact test/profile/source/runtime revisions and declared environment inputs so a pass/fail result cannot silently float across unrelated versions or targets.
